song.author: Matt Maher, Chris Tomlin, Louie Giglio
song.lyrics:
[V1] .D A I lift my hands to the coming King, . D G To the great I AM, to You I sing, . D A A7 D For You're the One who reigns within my heart.
[V2] . D A And I will serve no foreign god, . G D Or any other treasure; . A You are my heart's desire, . G D Spirit without measure. . G Unto Your name . A A7 D I will bring my sacrifice.
song.title: I Lift My Hands
